title: DO_SIGN returns -EINVAL for KEY_PUBLIC; header documents -EBADF
description: Trigger: call CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_DO_SIGN with key_fd pointing to a KEY fd that has key_type == CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_PUBLIC. The ioctl.h comment documents: 'Returns -EBADF if key_fd is not a valid KEY fd.' But ioctl_do_sign line 1079-1082 checks (key_state->key_type == CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_PUBLIC) and returns -EINVAL, not -EBADF. The documented errno for 'wrong key type' is -EINVAL (line 251 notes -EINVAL for 'digest_len is 0 or exceeds'), but -EBADF is documented for 'not a valid KEY fd'. The ABI mismatch means callers who check errno to distinguish 'bad fd' from 'wrong key type' cannot do so. Same bug exists in DO_AGREE (ioctl_do_agree line 1262-1265).
